Anime for beginners: five starter shows picked for people who bounced off their first try.

The trick is matching the show to taste, so each slide says who the pick is for. Thriller friend? Death Note. Wants one complete story with a real ending? Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood.

Which show made anime click for you?
